name: Ruhrgebiet
author: pierreggt
description: Map of the Ruhrgebiet & Düsseldorf & Münster, Germany: Dortmund, Essen, Bochum, Duisburg, Wuppertal, Düsseldorf and Münster, sharing the VRR/Rhein-Ruhr-Express regional rail network, from Dortmund and Düsseldorf Airports across the whole densely urbanized region. Residential population comes from the official 2022 census 100m population grid (Zensus 2022), with real German labor-market statistics (official employment counts and municipality-to-municipality commuter flows) anchoring 14 major municipalities across the region, including all 7 core cities.
data_source: OSMZensus 2022 (Destatis), Beschäftigtenstatistik BA + Pendlerrechnung der Länder (regionalstatistik.de/GENESIS-Online), OSM, Overture Maps
